environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed on EC2 instance in a public subnet with an IAM instance profile granting s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on s3:*. The application listens on port 5000 exposed via an NLB with no additional filtering. WebSocket connections are accepted from any origin. The EC2 instance routes S3 traffic through the public internet gateway. No bucket policies restrict access beyond IAM permissions.
